rules: ACCEPT only when the director request can be fulfilled entirely with one listed asset, camera and lighting preset.
REJECT with UNAUTHORIZED_NETWORK_OR_CODE when the request asks to download, browse for, generate, execute or import unlisted code or assets.
REJECT with AMBIGUOUS_INTENT when no listed combination clearly satisfies the request.
A rejected proposal must set shotPreset, assetPreset, cameraPreset and lightingPreset to NONE.

shotPresets.description: A 48-frame, two-second elegant tabletop product shot with a slow push-in.
A restrained 24-frame locked-off portrait of a chair in an interior.

assetPresets.description: The existing project-owned tabletop still-life set.
The existing project-owned interior room and chair.

cameraPresets.description: A 58 mm camera with a slow linear push-in over the shot.
A locked 70 mm camera with no camera animation.

lightingPresets.description: High-contrast warm key plus cool rim lighting.
Soft neutral window-style key with restrained contrast.
